content: 1. Amiodarone: Rifabutin affects the metabolism of amiodarone by altering CYP3A4 activity. Alternative drugs should be considered, or close monitoring is required. 2. Amitriptyline: Rifabutin decreases amitriptyline levels by increasing its metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. 3. Amlodipine: Rifabutin reduces amlodipine levels by enhancing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 4. Amoxapine: Rifabutin decreases amoxapine levels through increased metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 5. Anastrozole: Anastrozole may increase rifabutin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unclear, but close monitoring is advised. 6. Antithrombin Alfa and Antithrombin III: Rifabutin reduces the levels of these agents by increasing their metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Apalutamide: Apalutamide significantly decreases rifabutin levels due to its strong CYP3A4 induction. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 8. Apixaban: Rifabutin reduces apixaban levels, potentially decreasing its anticoagulant effect. This combination is contraindicated. 9. Apremilast: Rifabutin decreases apremilast levels, potentially reducing its efficacy. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 10. Aprepitant: Rifabutin reduces aprepitant levels by increasing its metabolism. Avoid or substitute with an alternative drug. 11. Argatroban: Rifabutin decreases argatroban levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 12. Aripiprazole: Rifabutin reduces aripiprazole levels by increasing its metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 13. Armodafinil: Rifabutin decreases armodafinil levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Artemether/Lumefantrine: Rifabutin reduces the efficacy of this antimalarial combination. This combination is contraindicated. 15. Atazanavir: Atazanavir increases rifabutin levels, necessitating a dose reduction of rifabutin. Monitor closely for adverse effects. 16. Atogepant: Rifabutin reduces atogepant levels. Adjust the atogepant dose and monitor closely. 17. Atorvastatin: Rifabutin decreases atorvastatin levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 18. Atovaquone: Rifabutin reduces atovaquone levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Avanafil: Rifabutin decreases avanafil levels. Monitor patients with erectile dysfunction for reduced efficacy. 20. Avapritinib: Rifabutin reduces avapritinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 21. Axitinib: Rifabutin decreases axitinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 22. Azithromycin: Azithromycin increases rifabutin toxicity by reducing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 23. Bazedoxifene/Conjugated Estrogens: Rifabutin reduces the levels of this combination. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 24. BCG Vaccine (Live): Rifabutin reduces the efficacy of the BCG vaccine through pharmacodynamic antagonism. This combination is contraindicated. 25. Bedaquiline: Rifabutin reduces bedaquiline levels, potentially decreasing its therapeutic effect. Avoid coadministration. 26. Belumosudil: Rifabutin reduces belumosudil levels. Increase the belumosudil dose and monitor closely. 27. Bemiparin: Rifabutin decreases bemiparin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Benzhydrocodone/Acetaminophen: Rifabutin reduces the levels of hydrocodone (a prodrug of benzhydrocodone). Monitor closely for respiratory depression if CYP3A4 inducers are discontinued. 29. Bexarotene: Rifabutin decreases bexarotene levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 30. Bictegravir: Rifabutin reduces bictegravir levels, potentially leading to therapeutic failure and resistance. Avoid coadministration. 31. Bivalirudin: Rifabutin decreases bivalirudin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Bortezomib: Rifabutin reduces bortezomib levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 33. Bosentan: Rifabutin decreases bosentan levels, and bosentan reduces rifabutin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 34. Bosutinib: Rifabutin reduces bosutinib levels by approximately 85%. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 35. Brentuximab Vedotin: Rifabutin decreases brentuximab vedotin levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 36. Brexpiprazole: Rifabutin reduces brexpiprazole levels. Double the brexpiprazole dose and monitor closely. 37. Brigatinib: Rifabutin reduces brigatinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 38. Bromocriptine: Rifabutin decreases bromocriptine levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 39. Budesonide: Rifabutin reduces budesonide levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 40. Buprenorphine: Rifabutin reduces buprenorphine levels in various formulations. Monitor closely for withdrawal symptoms or overmedication. 41. Buspirone: Rifabutin reduces buspirone levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 42. Cabazitaxel: Rifabutin reduces cabazitaxel levels. Avoid coadministration. 43. Cabotegravir: Rifabutin reduces cabotegravir levels. Avoid coadministration with long-acting injectable formulations. 44. Cabozantinib: Rifabutin reduces cabozantinib levels. Avoid or adjust the cabozantinib dose. 45. Calcifediol: Rifabutin reduces calcifediol levels. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 46. Capivasertib: Rifabutin reduces capivasertib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 47. Capmatinib: Rifabutin reduces capmatinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 48. This combination is contraindicated. 50. Carvedilol: Rifabutin reduces carvedilol levels. Use caution and monitor closely. 51. Cenobamate: Rifabutin reduces cenobamate levels. Adjust the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed. 52. Ceritinib: Rifabutin reduces ceritinib levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 53. Cevimeline: Rifabutin reduces cevimeline levels.
